summary.request: Each customer subscription contract line gets a Cost Center Reference. When recurring billing creates the invoices, every invoice line must show the reference, and it must still be visible on the posted invoice lines and archived billing lines.
summary.business-process: Subscription Billing recurring billing: billing proposal, contract invoice creation and sales invoice posting with billing line archiving

data-flow.to: Cust. Sub. Contract Line."Cost Center Reference"
data-flow.note: Entered on the customer contract line subpage extension.

Billing Proposal OnAfterUpdateBillingLineFromSubscriptionLine: Get the contract line by SubscriptionLine."Subscription Contract No." and "Subscription Contract Line No." (customer partner only) and assign; runs before the insert, no Modify.
Create Billing Documents OnBeforeInsertTempBillingLine. The temporary line groups all billing lines of one subscription line; the winner rule is open (cc-ref-period-conflict).
Create Billing Documents OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine: assign from TempBillingLine; the line is inserted right after, so no Modify and no lookup by Document No.
Standard posting, InitFromSalesLine; requires same field number and type.
The app archives billing lines with TransferFields when the invoice is posted.
Contract credit memos are created through the same events and posted with TransferFields.
Cancel/Correct via Copy Document Mgt. copies the line with TransferFields; the reference is business data, so it stays mirrored with no code.

data-flow.to: Sales Shipment Line / Return Receipt Line
data-flow.note: Article-chosen target; kept unless the requester excludes it.
Article-chosen target; kept unless the requester excludes it.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy the reference from the Cust. Sub. Contract Line to the new Billing Line.
guards: Exit when SubscriptionLine.Partner is not Customer (vendor contract lines are a different table).
SetLoadFields on the contract line before Get; exit quietly when Get fails.
No Modify: the event runs before the insert.
No UI calls: billing can run from a job queue (Auto Contract Billing).

subscriptions.purpose: Copy the reference from the Billing Line to the grouping temporary billing line, which does not carry custom fields by itself.
guards: Apply the agreed winner rule when grouped billing lines carry different references (open question cc-ref-period-conflict); otherwise the last line read silently wins.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy the reference from the temporary billing line to the Sales Line before it is inserted.
guards: Read from TempBillingLine, never look up Billing Line by the sales line's Document No. (not yet linked).
No Modify and no later patch with Modify(true) after OnAfterInsertSalesLineFromBillingLine.
No UI calls: billing may run in a job queue; documents committed before an error stay.

lifecycle.step: Add a dependency on the Subscription Billing app (publisher Microsoft, id 3099ffc7-4cf7-4df6-9b96-7e4bc2bb587c) in app.json.
Set DataClassification = CustomerContent on every Cost Center Reference field, since table extensions have no table-level value to inherit; never leave ToBeClassified.
Decide permission set entries for new objects; this design adds only table extensions, page extensions and a non-exposed subscriber codeunit.
Keep all three subscribers non-interactive because Auto Contract Billing (codeunit 8014) runs Create Billing Documents from a job queue entry; let errors propagate.
No data upgrade is designed: existing contract lines and already-created billing lines start blank. Whether to backfill is an open question (cc-ref-backfill).

tests.given: A customer subscription contract with a contract line whose Cost Center Reference is a random Code[20] value
tests.when: A billing proposal is created for the contract
tests.then: Every Billing Line for that contract line carries the same Cost Center Reference

tests.given: Billing lines with a Cost Center Reference from the contract line
tests.when: Create Billing Documents creates the sales invoice
tests.then: Each contract invoice Sales Line carries the reference (proving the temporary-line and sales-line hops) and no error is raised by the contract-change checks

tests.given: A contract invoice whose lines carry the reference
tests.then: Each Sales Invoice Line and each Billing Line Archive record for it carries the reference

tests.given: A contract line with a Cost Center Reference of the full field length
tests.when: The proposal is created, the invoice created and posted
tests.then: The full value is read back unchanged on Billing Line, Sales Line, Sales Invoice Line and Billing Line Archive (no TransferFields length error)

tests.given: A contract line with a reference and billing that produces a credit memo
tests.when: The credit memo is created and posted
tests.then: The Sales Line and the Sales Cr.Memo Line carry the reference

tests.given: A posted contract invoice whose lines carry the reference
tests.when: The posted invoice is cancelled (corrective credit memo)
tests.then: The posted Sales Cr.Memo Line carries the same reference

tests.given: A vendor subscription contract with billing lines
tests.then: The subscriber exits without error and does not try to read a customer contract line

tests.given: Two billing periods for one subscription line whose billing lines carry different references
tests.when: Create Billing Documents groups them into one sales line
tests.then: The sales line carries the reference chosen by the agreed winner rule (cc-ref-period-conflict)

tests.given: Billing configured to run without a user (no UI handlers registered)
tests.when: Create Billing Documents runs as Auto Contract Billing would
tests.then: Documents are created with the reference and no UI callback is raised

tests.given: A contract invoice line with the reference
tests.when: The document is archived (and, if kept, shipped or returned)
tests.then: Sales Line Archive (and Sales Shipment Line / Return Receipt Line if kept) carry the reference

knowledge.used-for: Defines the full path contract line -> billing line -> temporary billing line -> sales line -> posted line / billing line archive and the three events used.
constraints: Add the field to Cust. Sub. Contract Line, Billing Line, Sales Line and Sales Invoice Line, and to Billing Line Archive when users need it on archived billing lines.
Use the same field number and type on Billing Line and Billing Line Archive, and on the sales and posted line tables.
Subscribe to OnAfterUpdateBillingLineFromSubscriptionLine, OnBeforeInsertTempBillingLine and OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine; no Modify is needed because each runs before its insert.
Do not copy only in OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine without filling the temporary line, and do not look up Billing Line by the sales line's Document No.
Decide which value wins when billing lines grouped into one temporary line differ; otherwise the last line read silently wins.
Credit memos follow the same path; the design needs a dependency on Subscription Billing (3099ffc7-4cf7-4df6-9b96-7e4bc2bb587c).

knowledge.used-for: Sets values before the sales line insert and rules out patching the created contract invoice; background-billing guard.
constraints: Set line values in OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine, read from TempBillingLine.
Do not adjust created contract invoice lines afterwards with Modify(true); Modify(false) to bypass checks is no better.
Subscribers in this path must not need UI; an error stops the run but documents committed before it stay.
Own extension fields that the app does not check can still be changed later.

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring the line field on every sales TransferFields target (posted lines and Sales Line Archive).
constraints: Give the field the same number, name, type and length on the source and every target table the plan needs.

For a line field, cover the line tables: Sales Shipment Line, Sales Invoice Line, Sales Cr.Memo Line, Return Receipt Line and Sales Line Archive, unless the plan states a document type never needs it.
No subscriber is needed for these stages; keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables.
Do not patch posted lines with an OnAfter insert subscriber and Modify.

knowledge.used-for: Stage map for a custom sales field: posted lines, archive, page extensions, permission entries and read-back tests.
constraints: Decide which stages the field must reach and plan one step per stage.
Name the page extensions that show the field and permission set entries for any new objects.
Test by posting a document and reading the value back from every target.

knowledge.used-for: Type and length agreement across all mirrored tables.
constraints: Define the mirrored field with exactly the same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade, at creation time.
A shorter length on one side compiles but fails at runtime once a value exceeds it.

knowledge.used-for: Billing can run from Auto Contract Billing in a job queue, so subscribers must be non-interactive.
constraints: No Confirm, Page/Report RunModal, upload/download or Message-based notification in code reached from the job queue.
Let failures propagate to the job queue log.

knowledge.used-for: Corrective credit memos copy mirrored line fields from the posted invoice.
constraints: Mirrored business data comes back on the corrective credit memo and needs no code.
Per-document state must be cleared in OnAfterCopySalesHeaderDone; the reference is treated here as business data.
Test Cancel on an invoice with the field filled and read the posted credit memo back.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltip placement for the new page fields.
constraints: From runtime 13.0 (BC24) define the tooltip on the table field and let bound page fields inherit it; before that, page-level tooltips are needed.
Tooltip text must say what the value is used for, not just repeat the caption, and must not invent behavior.

knowledge.used-for: Confirms bound page fields inherit the table-field tooltip; applies from BC24.
constraints: Do not duplicate a page-level ToolTip when the source table field supplies one (runtime 13.0 or later).
Add a page-level ToolTip only when none can be inherited or different help is needed.

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of the new table extension fields.
constraints: Every Normal field added by a tableextension must set its own DataClassification.
Choose the classification matching the stored data at definition time; ToBeClassified is not a safe default.

knowledge.used-for: Partial load of the contract line in the billing-line subscriber.
constraints: Call SetLoadFields with the fields read immediately before the Get.
Skip it where the read path reads most fields or the table is temporary.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures for customers, items and sales documents.
constraints: Build prerequisite records with Library codeunits (LibrarySales, LibraryInventory, LibraryRandom), parents first, validating foreign keys.
Generate incidental values with library codeunits; do not depend on existing records.
Use deliberately chosen values when the scenario depends on length, such as a full-length reference.

open-questions.question: What is the Cost Center Reference: free Code[20] text, a relation to an existing table (for example cost centers or a dimension value), or another type/length? Is it mandatory on a contract line before billing?

When billing lines of several periods for one subscription line are grouped into one invoice line and carry different references (the contract line changed between proposals), which reference wins: the latest billing line, the earliest, the current contract line value, or should billing stop with an error?
The articles also mirror the field on Sales Cr.Memo Line (contract and corrective credit memos), Sales Shipment Line, Return Receipt Line and Sales Line Archive. Keep all of them, or exclude any?

May a user change the reference on an unposted contract invoice line, or should it be read-only there (the app's change checks do not cover extension fields)? Should changing it on the contract line update billing lines already proposed?
Must existing contract lines or already-created billing lines and open contract invoices be filled when the extension is installed, or does the reference apply only to billing created afterwards?

Should the reference also be shown on the billing proposal (billing lines) page, posted credit memo subform or reports, in addition to the contract line, invoice line, posted invoice line and archived billing line pages?
Which BC version / runtime does the app target? From BC24 (runtime 13.0) the tooltip goes on the table field and is inherited by pages; earlier targets need page-level tooltips.
